sites.name: White Cloud Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: White Cloud Campground is located right off of Hwy 20 in a nice wooded area. Scotts Flat Resevoir is six miles from White Cloud Campsite. sites.restrictions: Potable water dependent on completion of water system maintenance.
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov

sites.name: Skillman Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Group Site: $110 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Not for drinking; water is available for animals/stock
sites.about: Skillman Campground is open to all users including equestrian, mountain bikers and OHV. It is located along Hwy 20. Some camp sites have corrals, hitching posts, and horse troughs.
